front_rule: First maximum negative adjacent-depth slope at native interfaces x>=dam; numerical front only
front_band_half_width_rule: max(0.1 m, max difference from selected front across all grids/CFL + selected dx)
uncertainty_rule: Cellwise abs(N3200 CFL.45 - N1600 CFL.45) + abs(N3200 CFL.225 - N3200 CFL.45), conservatively projected to common cells; measured differences, no rigorous bound
method: First-order piecewise-constant finite-volume HLLE with Einfeldt speeds, forward Euler homogeneous flux, then exact fixed-depth Manning decay (Lie split)
source_time_restriction: Nonnegative finite dt; exact isolated fixed-depth source decay has no explicit stability restriction. Coupled first-order splitting error measured by CFL halving.
validation: Reject nonfinite or nonpositive states at input, HLLE intermediate, homogeneous and source stages; no clipping or retry
boundary: One fixed reservoir ghost cell at each edge, refreshed for every homogeneous step; actual numerical flux saved
output_time_policy: Shorten last step to hit every requested time exactly; no time interpolation
